context: Ren and Mei chat casually after a long day.
purpose: Casual register reusing common stragglers (彼ら/使わ/すでに/とにかく) naturally.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 今日の打ち合わせ、長かったね。
lines.style: tired young man voice, soft warm relaxed delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: うん、彼らの説明、長すぎたよね。
lines.en: Yeah, their explanation was too long.
lines.style: soft warm woman voice, gentle relaxed delivery throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 資料は、すでに読んでたのにね。
lines.en: We'd already read the materials, though.
lines.style: mildly exasperated young man voice, soft warm relaxed delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 彼ら、同じ言葉を何度も使ってた。
lines.en: They used the same words over and over.
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm amused delivery throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 難しい言葉ばかり使われて、疲れたよ。
lines.en: So many hard words were used; I'm tired.
lines.style: weary young man voice, soft warm relaxed delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 全く、もっと簡単でいいのにね。
lines.en: Honestly, it could be much simpler.
lines.style: soft woman voice, gentle warm sympathetic delivery throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: とにかく、今日は早く休もう。
lines.style: gentle young man voice, soft warm caring delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: うん、とにかくお茶でも飲もう。
lines.en: Yeah, let's at least have some tea.
lines.style: warm woman voice, gentle affectionate delivery throughout
